summary: Iteration 22 retest of iteration_21 defects. All 3 HIGH-priority fixes verified LIVE on mobile viewport 390x844 with a brand-new signup (hqob1789014102@gmail.com / OB 1789014102 / Test1234!). FIX A PASS: RoleStep 'Farm Owner' + role-continue-btn advances, and the Finish summary correctly renders 'Role: Farm Owner' (not 'Not set'). profileRepo.setRole is now an upsert with onConflict:'user_id' and role is persisted on public.user_profiles. FIX B PASS: after role=done, team=done, farms/paddocks/machinery/chemicals=skipped, the Finish→Home routing shows home-setup-card at exactly 33% ('You're 33% of the way there — add the rest whenever you like'), confirming the percent formula now counts only .done and no longer treats skipped as complete. FIX C-1 PASS: tapping home-setup-card on Home immediately switches back to <Onboarding/> — role-owner and onboarding-skip-all are both re-rendered — proving the shared React Query cache key ['user_profile', userId] invalidation triggers a re-render in PostAuthShell as designed. FIX C-2 PASS: More tab shows 'Setup Chaser' with a 33% badge (link-setup-chaser testID present) and tapping it also switches back to <Onboarding/>. No 4xx/5xx observed in the console. Only pre-existing RN-web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' styles) present, not introduced this iteration. No React Native red screens. NOT exercised in this pass (deferred, unchanged from iter_21 code review): (a) direct Supabase SELECT of user_profiles.role for the test user_id, (b) regression test that an existing beta user with backfilled onboarding_completed_at skips the wizard (would need to sign in as prior test account and preserve migration marker across contexts), (c) two-context RLS cross-tenant read of user_profiles, and (d) full end-to-end crop-stage + editable-weather-audit UI test on /records/new → /records/[id]. Crop-stage chips (crop-stage-chips, crop-stage-<id>) and weather-edited badge + auto-original strip are wired in code exactly per spec (records/new.tsx:370-398 renders stagesForCrop(f.crop) chips; editWeather() flips weatherEdited=true and buildJob() emits temperature_c_auto/humidity_auto/delta_t_auto/wind_speed_auto/wind_direction_auto + weather_edited fields) but were not exercised live in this pass because a brand-new signup has no seed farms/paddocks/machinery/chemicals to select on /records/new — the Start Job button requires all 6 REQUIRED fields.

integration_issues.issue: Not exercised this pass — still needs a two-context (browser.new_context()) test where User B's supabase.from('user_profiles').select().eq('user_id', UserA_id) returns empty.

Not exercised in this pass because a brand-new signup has no seed data on /records/new (all 6 REQUIRED chips are empty). To exercise live, seed one farm+paddock+machine+chem during onboarding (don't skip those steps) then take the Wheat path.

action_items: OPTIONAL retest to close the remaining coverage gaps: (a) sign up two businesses in separate contexts and confirm cross-tenant SELECT on user_profiles is empty for the other user; (b) run onboarding to completion including team+farm+paddock+machinery+chemical, then on /records/new pick Wheat → crop-stage-tillering, Start Job → edit temperature_c on the finish weather form → save-completed-btn → open /records/[id] and assert record-weather-edited-badge + record-auto-original visible and the crop stage row shows 'Tillering'; (c) sign in as a pre-existing backfilled beta account and confirm the tab stack renders without the wizard.
No fixes required on the 3 defects flagged in iteration_21 — all three verified fixed live.
critical_code_review_comments: onboarding.ts:77-124 — setRole/markStep/complete/resume now consistently upsert with onConflict:'user_id' and invalidate the ['user_profile', userId] query key. Shared cache = single source of truth for PostAuthShell + tabs + More. Good.
onboarding.ts:150-160 — percent now counts only progress[s]?.done for the 6 non-'finish' steps. Matches spec.
_layout.tsx:63-76 — PostAuthShell branches on useOnboarding().needsOnboarding, so a resume() (completed_at=null) forces re-render into <Onboarding/> without a router.replace. Confirmed live.
(tabs)/index.tsx:192 — home-setup-card renders only when onboarding_completed_at is truthy AND percent between 1 and 99 (exclusive). Confirmed shows at 33% after mixed done+skipped.
(tabs)/more.tsx:158-176 — link-setup-chaser has a percent badge that hides at 100%. Correct wiring.
records/new.tsx:370-398 (unchanged from iter_21) — crop-stage chip list is driven by stagesForCrop(f.crop); Wheat → cereals Zadoks list including 'tillering', 'stem_elongation' etc. Correct.
records/new.tsx:132-143, 219-268 (unchanged from iter_21) — weatherEdited flag + *_auto snapshot + weather_edited/*_auto payload wiring for the audit trail is correct.
